name: PUBLIC AFFAIRS
source:
To the public, Veronica Bennett is everything a struggling city needs: a respected public servant, a devoted wife, a loving mother, and a woman who has built her reputation on never compromising her principles.

When the opportunity to run for mayor arises, Verónica moves with her husband and son into a campaign residence. But the campaign also forces her to work alongside a man with whom she has a distant relationship a rude and shameless political operative whose methods she despises… and whose ability to get results she cannot deny.

At first, Veronica rejects every shortcut he offers... Then one small favor protects the campaign... Another produces something genuinely good for the community.

And every victory makes the next compromise easier to justify...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/introducing-my-171347479]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在公众眼中，维罗妮卡·贝内特正是这座深陷困境的城市所迫切需要的一切：一位受人敬重的公职人员、一位忠贞的妻子、一位慈爱的母亲，更是一位凭着绝不向原则妥协而树立起声望的女性。

当竞选市长的契机降临时，维罗妮卡带着丈夫和儿子搬进了竞选宅邸。但这场选战也迫使她不得不与一个平时关系疏远的男人共事——那是个粗鲁无礼、厚颜无耻的政治操盘手，她虽对他的手段深恶痛绝……却又无法否认他拿出实际成果的手腕。

起初，维罗妮卡断然拒绝了他提出的每一条捷径……直到一次小小的人情交易保住了选情……紧接着又一次妥协为社区带来了实实在在的福祉。

而每一次胜利，都让下一次妥协变得更容易心安理得……

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/introducing-my-171347479]Patreon[/url]]
